messages.author: 5a7c50cc48efe23c
messages.subject: Weird scaled predictions?
parts:
Hi there,

I have successful generated predictions using a joint binomial-gamma model and am looking at my predictions for the gamma distribution. I've found that pretty much consistently my predictions need to be multiplied by 2 to be in the range of the observations. Is there a scaling factor happening somewhere behind the scenes? Does this have to do with the joint model? Or perhaps how I'm defining my z and y response variables? Any insight would be appreciated.

See code below.

### SET UP DATASETS
FL_dataTRAIN<-FL_data8[which(FL_data8$time<13),]
FL_dataPRED<-FL_data8[which(FL_data8$time>12),]
######

#### try z and y with ZERO now being set to WHO low threshold of 20000 cells/ML
z<-(FL_dataTRAIN$Cyano>20000)+0
y<-ifelse(FL_dataTRAIN$Cyano<20000,NA,1)*FL_dataTRAIN$Cyano

z.pred<-(FL_dataPRED$Cyano>20000)+0
y.pred<-ifelse(FL_dataPRED$Cyano<20000,NA,1)*FL_dataPRED$Cyano

######### SCALE COVARIATES##################
mean_covariates2 = apply(FL_dataTRAIN[,6:14],2,mean)
sd_covariates2 = apply(FL_dataTRAIN[,6:14],2,sd)

FL_dataTRAIN[,6:14] =
  scale(FL_dataTRAIN[,6:14],
        mean_covariates2, sd_covariates2)
########
mean_covariates3 = apply(FL_dataPRED[,6:14],2,mean)
sd_covariates3 = apply(FL_dataPRED[,6:14],2,sd)

FL_dataPRED[,6:14] =
  scale(FL_dataPRED[,6:14],
        mean_covariates3, sd_covariates3)

####Setting priors on the SPDE for variance and range
A <-inla.spde.make.A(mesh, loc=as.matrix(coords[,1:2]))
sigma0 = 1
size = min(c(diff(range(mesh$loc[, 1])), diff(range(mesh$loc[, 2]))))
range0 = size / 5
kappa0 = sqrt(8) / range0
tau0 = 1 / (sqrt(4 * pi) * kappa0 * sigma0)
spde = inla.spde2.matern(mesh,alpha=2,
                         B.tau = cbind(log(tau0), -1, +1),
                         B.kappa = cbind(log(kappa0), 0, -1),
                         theta.prior.mean = c(0, 0),
                         theta.prior.prec = c(0.1, 1) )

### SET UP OBSERVATION MATRICES
FL_dataTRAIN$time = rep(1:12,each = n_stations)
FL_dataPRED$time=rep(13,each = n_stations)
#####
A.est <- inla.spde.make.A(
  mesh=mesh, 
  loc=
    as.matrix(FL_dataTRAIN[,4:5]),
  group=FL_dataTRAIN$time,
  n.group=n_days
)
  
A.pred =
  inla.spde.make.A(mesh,
                   loc=
                     as.matrix(FL_dataPRED[,4:5]),
                   group=i_day,n.group=n_days)

#### index for binomial distribution?
ix1 <- inla.spde.make.index('i', spde$n.spde, n.group=n_days) 

### two indexes for the two gamma paramaters, K (shape parameter) and scale parameter??
ix2 <- inla.spde.make.index('ic', spde$n.spde, n.group=n_days) 
iu <- inla.spde.make.index('j', spde$n.spde, n.group=n_days) 
#####

####################### SET UP STACKS############################
stk.z <- inla.stack(tag='est.z', 
                    data=list(y=cbind(z, NA), link=1), 
                    A=list(A.est, 1), 
                    effects=list(
                      ix1, 
                      data.frame(z.b0=1, 
                                 Temp=FL_dataTRAIN$Atemp, Prec=FL_dataTRAIN$Precip,Speed=FL_dataTRAIN$wSPEED)))#,Vol=FL_dataTRAIN$vol,Area=FL_dataTRAIN$SArea,Stress=FL_dataTRAIN$wSTRESS,Speed=FL_dataTRAIN$wSPEED,depthM=FL_dataTRAIN$depthMAX)))
stk.y <- inla.stack(tag='est.y', 
                    data=list(y=cbind(NA, y), 
                              link=2), 
                    A=list(A.est, 1), 
                    effects=list(
                      c(ix2, iu), 
                      data.frame(y.b0=1, 
                                 Temp=FL_dataTRAIN$Atemp, Prec=FL_dataTRAIN$Precip,Speed=FL_dataTRAIN$wSPEED)))#,Vol=FL_dataTRAIN$vol,Area=FL_dataTRAIN$SArea,Stress=FL_dataTRAIN$wSTRESS,depthM=FL_dataTRAIN$depthMAX)))
g<-rep(NA,1282)
pred.z <- inla.stack(tag='pred.z', 
                     data=list(y=cbind(NA,g), link=1), 
                     A=list(A.pred, 1), 
                     effects=list(
                       ix1, 
                       data.frame(z.b0=1, 
                                  Temp=FL_dataPRED$Atemp, Prec=FL_dataPRED$Precip,Speed=FL_dataPRED$wSPEED)))#,Vol=FL_dataPRED$vol,Area=FL_dataPRED$SArea,Stress=FL_dataPRED$wSTRESS,Speed=FL_dataPRED$wSPEED,depthM=FL_dataPRED$depthMAX)))
pred.y <- inla.stack(tag='pred.y', 
                     data=list(y=cbind(NA,g),link=2), 
                     A=list(A.pred, 1), 
                     effects=list(
                       c(ix2, iu), 
                       data.frame(y.b0=1, 
                                  Temp=FL_dataPRED$Atemp, Prec=FL_dataPRED$Precip,Speed=FL_dataPRED$wSPEED)))#,Vol=FL_dataPRED$vol,Area=FL_dataPRED$SArea,Stress=FL_dataPRED$wSTRESS,Speed=FL_dataPRED$wSPEED,depthM=FL_dataPRED$depthMAX)))

jdat <- inla.stack(stk.z, stk.y, pred.z,pred.y)

## SET UP MODEL
form <- y ~ 0 + z.b0 + y.b0+Temp+Prec+Speed+
  f(i, model=spde, group=i.group, control.group=list(model='ar1')) +  
  f(ic, copy='i', group=ic.group, fixed=FALSE) + 
  f(j, model=spde, group=j.group, control.group=list(model='ar1'))    

### run INLA model
res <- inla(form, family=c('binomial', 'gamma'), 
            data=inla.stack.data(jdat), 
            verbose=TRUE, 
            control.inla=list(strategy='gaussian'), control.fixed=list(prec.intercept=1),
            control.predictor=list(A=inla.stack.A(jdat), 
                                   compute=TRUE, 
                                   link=inla.stack.data(jdat)$link))

print(summary(res))
################## PREDICTIONS ##########################
## Calculate validation data information
validation = list()

 field_pred_mean <- res$summary.fitted.values[inla.stack.index(jdat,"pred.y")$data, "mean"]
 field_pred_sd <- res$summary.fitted.values[inla.stack.index(jdat,"pred.y")$data, "sd"]
###

just a check. you're sure this is not because of over-smoothing?
